ISSUE_KIND: streetlight
ISSUE: Missing fixture/globe on the left arm and missing globe/enclosure on the right arm of a decorative lamppost
DETAILS: The photo shows the top of a decorative dual-arm lamppost against a clear blue daytime sky with the sun behind it. The left arm is missing its luminaire/lamp assembly (only exposed wiring/hardware remains), and the right arm is missing its globe/diffuser, exposing an LED corn bulb lamp. No user note was provided.
ORGANIZATION: New York City Department of Transportation
DEPARTMENT: Division of Traffic Operations
WHY: The decorative lamppost is located along West 86th Street, a city street in Manhattan. The New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) is responsible for maintaining all municipal streetlights on New York City streets and roadways.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "NYC DOT maintains nearly 400,000 streetlights throughout New York City."
COVERAGE_URL: https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/infrastructure/infrastructure.shtml
